settings.question: How long does order processing and delivery take?
settings.answer: All orders are carefully packed and dispatched from our atelier within 24 to 48 business hours. Delivery typically takes 2 to 4 business days for Express delivery and 4 to 7 business days for Standard shipping. As soon as your parcel is dispatched, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with an active live tracking link.

settings.question: Is worldwide shipping free?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer free tracked shipping on all qualifying orders over €50. You can track your real-time progress toward free shipping directly inside your shopping cart.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: Because our dispatch team works promptly, please reach out to us at store.bssoln@gmail.com within 2 hours of placing your order. For personalized custom-engraved pieces, changes cannot be made once laser engraving has commenced.

settings.question: How do I track my shipment?
settings.answer: Once your order leaves our studio, you will receive an automated email containing your tracking number and a direct carrier link. You can also log into your Aurelle customer account anytime to view real-time fulfillment updates.

settings.question: How does bespoke laser engraving work?
settings.answer: Select any engravable jewelry piece, choose your character count, and enter your custom text (initials, names, memorable dates, Roman numerals, or coordinates). Each piece is individually crafted in-house using high-precision microscopic laser engraving for razor-sharp clarity.

settings.question: Can special symbols, hearts, or emojis be engraved?
settings.answer: Yes! We support standard heart symbols (♡, ♥), infinity signs (∞), stars (✦), Roman numerals, and zodiac symbols. Simply paste the symbol into the personalization field or leave a note during checkout.

settings.question: Will the engraving ever fade or wear off?
settings.answer: Never. Our fiber laser technology removes microscopic layers of metal beneath the surface, creating an indelible, permanent engraving that will not rub off, wash away, or fade over time.

settings.question: Can engraved personalized items be returned?
settings.answer: Because custom-engraved pieces are created exclusively to your personal specifications, they cannot be returned or exchanged unless there was a manufacturing flaw or spelling error on our side. We double-check every engraving before shipping.

settings.question: Is Aurelle jewelry truly 100% waterproof?
settings.answer: Yes, 100%. Our jewelry is engineered from surgical-grade 316L stainless steel finished with vacuum-bonded 18K gold PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) coating. You can wear it in the shower, swimming pool, ocean, during heavy gym workouts, and in saunas without taking it off.

settings.question: Will it tarnish, rust, or turn my skin green?
settings.answer: No, never. Unlike fast-fashion jewelry made from copper or brass, 316L stainless steel does not oxidize or react with water, sweat, or humidity. Your skin will never turn green or irritated.

settings.question: Is Aurelle jewelry safe for sensitive skin (Hypoallergenic)?
settings.answer: Yes. All of our pieces are 100% nickel-free, lead-free, and cadmium-free. They are dermatologist-approved and hypoallergenic, making them comfortable for everyday wear even on the most sensitive skin.

settings.question: What is 18K Gold PVD coating?
settings.answer: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) is an advanced high-vacuum coating process where real 18-karat gold is vaporized and bonded at a molecular level onto the steel. It creates a surface up to 10 times thicker and more scratch-resistant than standard electroplating.

settings.question: How should I clean my Aurelle pieces?
settings.answer: Cleaning is simple and effortless: rinse your jewelry under warm water with a touch of mild dish soap, gently clean with a soft toothbrush if needed, and pat dry with a soft microfiber cloth. An Aurelle polishing cloth is included with every order.

settings.question: Can I spray perfume or apply lotions while wearing it?
settings.answer: While our PVD coating resists most everyday cosmetics, we recommend allowing perfumes, alcohol-based body sprays, and heavy creams to absorb into your skin for a minute before putting on your jewelry to maintain its mirror-like luster.

settings.question: How should I store my jewelry when not in use?
settings.answer: We suggest storing each piece in the signature Aurelle protective pouch or jewelry box provided. Storing pieces separately prevents chain links from tangling and protects the high-polish finish.

settings.question: How do I measure my ring size at home?
settings.answer: Visit our dedicated Size Guide page! You can wrap a narrow strip of paper around the base of your finger, mark the overlap, measure the millimeters, and compare with our US/EU chart. If you are between two sizes, we always recommend sizing up.

settings.question: Are your necklaces and bracelets adjustable?
settings.answer: Yes! Most of our pendant necklaces and chain bracelets feature built-in 5cm extension chains (for example, 40cm + 5cm), allowing you to adjust the drop length for different necklines or layering combinations.

settings.question: What if an unengraved ring doesn't fit?
settings.answer: If an unengraved ring or bracelet does not fit comfortably, you can exchange it within 14 days of delivery. Simply contact our support team and we will guide you through a quick exchange.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a hassle-free 14-day return window from the date of delivery for all non-personalized, unworn items in their original packaging. Once we receive and inspect your return, a full refund is processed to your original payment method.

settings.question: Do you offer a Lifetime Color Warranty?
settings.answer: Yes! We stand behind our quality with a Lifetime Color & Tarnish Warranty. If your jewelry ever tarnishes, oxidizes, or loses its gold color, simply contact us with a photo and your order number for a complimentary replacement.
